context.issue_text: Cross-instance-same-tenant attachment-content denial is timing-distinguishable from cross-tenant/never-issued denial via an unconditional artifact-blob read. Affects lib/letflow/repository/attachments.ex (~362-445). get_content/2 reads the full artifact byte blob unconditionally whenever the attachment metadata row exists, regardless of instance_id. The instance_id check in fetch_scoped_attachment_content/4 (instances.ex ~1156) happens AFTER get_content/2 returns. This makes cross-instance-same-tenant denials cost 2 Repo round-trips vs 1 for cross-tenant/never-issued. See docs/issues/ISS-0785.yaml for full detail.
